final_assessment: Five decisions captured: sign-off frequency is its own setting, off by default, with change and program values (amends R-adf-2, stop and resolution recorded); a change-level brief covers one change; a program sign-off holds the program's completion in every pr mode and the program PR's READY flip under per-architecture; the engine computes the brief from the trail, with the AI writing what was built, new seams and deviations as one account record per change at apply's end; the reader takes the account only when sign-off is on, so G0 needs no new exception. One open question remains (where the brief is saved and what a sign-off records), with a standing recommendation. The stage likely exceeds the size ceiling at propose; a split between the account and brief renderer, and the sign-off setting with its holds, is the natural one.
